policy: Completed ticket index alternates directed evaluator cycle 5→8→13→5 and inverse. Each weight changes by ±1 on agreement with its assigned other horizon, clamped 1–16. No self-evaluation. All other selection and simulation logic preserved.
limitations: Agreement is a proxy, not proof of utility; correlated horizons, no physical Möbius topology asserted. Weights are bounded independently, not conserved. New seeds are synthetic generalization tests, not independent real-world evidence.
